title: YAMATO TAKERU
subtitle: the prince who fought fire with fire

lines.say: [scoffing] Kusanagi just means grass cutter? That's so lame!
[smirking] Not when the grass is on fire.
[shocked] ON FIRE?!
[storytelling] Meet Prince Yamato Takeru. So fierce, his own father was afraid of him, and kept sending him off to war.
cap: So fierce, his own father was {r:afraid} of him,
and kept sending him off to {r:war}.

lines.say: First target: the Kumaso brothers. Two warlords no army could beat.
cap: Two warlords no army could beat.

lines.say: So the prince let down his hair, put on a dress, and walked right into their feast.
cap: So the prince let down his hair,

lines.say: [laughing] He went undercover?!
[intense] They laughed. They drank. Then he pulled a dagger from his sleeve.
[gasping] Who... are you?
[cold] The emperor's son.
[weakly] Then take a new name. Yamato Takeru. The bravest in the land.
Next, he went east. His aunt, a priestess, gave him a sword from a serpent's tail, and a little bag.
cap: His aunt, a priestess, gave him

lines.say: [gently] Open it only if your life is in danger.
[ominous] A local chief led him into a field of tall grass. Then set it on fire. From every side.
cap: into a field of tall grass.

lines.say: [shouting] A TRAP!
[panicking] Use the sword! USE THE SWORD!
[intense] He swung it, and the grass around him fell flat. Then he opened the bag. A fire striker.
cap: and the grass around him fell {o:flat}.

lines.say: [confused] He fights fire with MORE fire?!
[excited] He lit a counter fire. The wind turned, and the flames roared back at the men who set them.
cap: at the men who set them.

lines.say: [awed] And that sword has been called Kusanagi ever since. The grass cutter.
cap: And that sword has been called

lines.say: [amazed] Okay. Grass cutter is the coolest name ever.
